page.overview:
Who is Doug Speedcheck?

Doug Speedcheck is a character in Cars 2.

He is a black Ford Mondeo British police officer. He is one of the policemen (although it cannot be said which one) who try to protect the Queen from Mater as he lands on the Queen's platform with a bomb implanted on him.
